### [`.well-known/agent-skills/[skill]/SKILL.md/route.ts`](../../app/.well-known/agent-skills/%5Bskill%5D/SKILL.md/route.ts)

Route `/.well-known/agent-skills/[skill]/SKILL.md` (route).

- `generateStaticParams` _function_
- `GET` _function_
- `dynamic` _const_: The skill artifacts themselves. The index publishes a SHA-256 of each one, so what is served here has to be the file on disk verbatim: no header, no footer, no locale, nothing computed.
- `dynamicParams` _const_

### [`.well-known/agent-skills/index.json/route.ts`](../../app/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json/route.ts)

Route `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `dynamic` _const_: The Agent Skills discovery index (Agent Skills Discovery RFC v0.2.0), at the path an agent looks for. Static: the skills are files in this repository, and the digests are computed from the same bytes the artifact route serves.

### [`.well-known/ai-catalog.json/route.ts`](../../app/.well-known/ai-catalog.json/route.ts)

Route `/.well-known/ai-catalog.json` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `dynamic` _const_: The ARD capability manifest. Also advertised as an `Agentmap` directive in robots.txt, which is the mechanism for an agent that reads robots.txt before it guesses at well-known URIs.

### [`.well-known/api-catalog/route.ts`](../../app/.well-known/api-catalog/route.ts)

Route `/.well-known/api-catalog` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `dynamic` _const_: The API catalog (RFC 9727): the path an agent guesses, so it finds the OpenAPI description of api.park.fan without a human handing over the URL.

### [`.well-known/mcp/server-card.json/route.ts`](../../app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json/route.ts)

Route `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `dynamic` _const_: The MCP server card (SEP-1649): how an agent finds the endpoint without being handed its URL. The tool names come from the server's own tool list, so the card can never name a tool that is not there.

### [`auth.md/route.ts`](../../app/auth.md/route.ts)

Route `/auth.md` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `dynamic` _const_: `/auth.md`: where an agent looks for how to get credentials.

### [`global-error.tsx`](../../app/global-error.tsx)

Route `/` (global-error).

- `default (GlobalError)` _component_: Last-resort error boundary: catches errors thrown in the ROOT layout itself (everything below is covered by app/[locale]/error.tsx).

### [`layout.tsx`](../../app/layout.tsx)

Route `/` (layout).

- `default (RootLayout)` _component_: Passes its children through: `<html>` and `<body>` render in [locale]/layout.tsx, for `lang`.
- `metadata` _const_: The icon set is generated by `pnpm generate:icons`, never hand-exported. `app/favicon.ico` comes from the file convention and is what Google reads; only what the convention cannot express is declared here.
- `viewport` _const_

### [`license.xml/route.ts`](../../app/license.xml/route.ts)

Route `/license.xml` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `dynamic` _const_: The RSL licence document (RSL 1.0), what robots.txt's `License:` directive and every page's `Link: …; rel="license"` header point at.

### [`llms.txt/route.ts`](../../app/llms.txt/route.ts)

Route `/llms.txt` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `dynamic` _const_: `/llms.txt` (llmstxt.org): the one file to read when an agent has the hostname and nothing else. English only, because it is read once, by something that then fetches the pages in its user's language.
- `revalidate` _const_: Rebuilt with the rest of the site; the parks in it change on the order of years.

### [`rss.xml/route.ts`](../../app/rss.xml/route.ts)

Route `/rss.xml` (route).

- `GET` _function_: Conventional discovery path — feed readers and humans try /rss.xml first. The real per-locale feed lives at /&lt;locale&gt;/blog/feed.xml; this just points there for the default locale.

### [`sitemap-attractions.xml/route.ts`](../../app/sitemap-attractions.xml/route.ts)

Route `/sitemap-attractions.xml` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `revalidate` _const_: Sitemap index over `/sitemap-attractions/<locale>.xml`: one file would hit the 50,000-URL and 50 MB ceilings. hreflang stays out of the children because every attraction page serves its alternates from its `<head>`.

### [`sitemap-attractions/[locale]/route.ts`](../../app/sitemap-attractions/%5Blocale%5D/route.ts)

Route `/sitemap-attractions/[locale]` (route).

- `generateStaticParams` _function_
- `GET` _function_
- `revalidate` _const_: One attraction sitemap per locale, `/sitemap-attractions/<locale>.xml`, so no file nears the 50,000-URL ceiling and Search Console reports coverage per locale. See docs/seo/sitemaps.md.

### [`sitemap-calendar.xml/route.ts`](../../app/sitemap-calendar.xml/route.ts)

Route `/sitemap-calendar.xml` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `revalidate` _const_: Sitemap index over `/sitemap-calendar/<locale>.xml`, kept out of `app/sitemap.ts` because the month pages with their hreflang block pushed that file toward the 50 MB limit, and a file over it is rejected whole.

### [`sitemap-news.xml/route.ts`](../../app/sitemap-news.xml/route.ts)

Route `/sitemap-news.xml` (route).

- `GET` _function_
- `revalidate` _const_: Google News sitemap: the news posts of the last two days, per locale, with `<news:news>`, because a news post is worth less every day it waits for a normal crawl. See `lib/seo/news-sitemap.ts` and docs/seo/sitemaps.md.
